Context: Risk and Hamshi,p Matrix

-Resoln. No. 11-1/2016-IC, dated 6-7-2017.  
The construct of the Risk and Hardship Matrix, proposed above, is a new paradigm intended to rationalize the myriad allowances, their categories and sub-categories that exist today. It would make the administration of these allowances simple and provide a framework for the Government for future inclusion of any new allowance, which can be placed in the appro priate cell depending upon the severity of the risk and hardship involved.
